criteria.evidence: HttpSourceLoader sends If-None-Match for any stored ETag, including W/"...", and If-Modified-Since for any stored Last-Modified (lines 68-69), then reuses the old cache bytes on 304 (lines 83-97). RepositoryClosureService.verifyUnchanged() (line 471) calls the loader again, so on 304 it compares old bytes with old bytes (line 454) instead of the current remote bytes. A correct server may legitimately answer 304 for a constant weak ETag across semantically equivalent representations or for a same-second Last-Modified change. In both real counterprobes the online run exited 0 and pinned the old bytes, the cached read-lock replay exited 0, while --no-cache against the same server exited 1 (LOCK_MISMATCH) and a fresh --no-cache run exited 1 (CHANGED_SOURCE). The byte-exact final comparison and pin/lock provenance are therefore not preserved.

findings.summary: 304 responses are accepted for weak ETags and second-granularity Last-Modified, so the final byte-exact check and pin/lock replay can silently use stale cache bytes. A weak ETag may remain valid for semantically equivalent but byte-different representations, and Last-Modified is not a strong validator without extra conditions. The implementation forwards any ETag with If-None-Match (line 68) or falls back to If-Modified-Since (line 69), and reuses the cached content on 304 (lines 83-97). The final verifyUnchanged() in RepositoryClosureService.java:471 therefore sees only the old cached bytes; the comparison at RepositoryClosureService.java:454 cannot raise CHANGED_SOURCE, and the pin/lock check at line 448 passes against the stale digest. Existing test conditionalFinalCheckDetectsChangesAndNoStoreIsNotPersistedByClosure changes the ETag on the second read and does not cover weak ETags or same-second Last-Modified.
findings.reproduction: Local Node server (build/reviewer/weak-validators/server.js) serving a valid Dep model and index. Weak scenario: constant ETag W/"dep-logical-1"; A sha256 4579d2317136de116ddc45cb7ca4d2e1b7b37c5efdee29e1b240ca6b17d5c04b; B (comment-only change) sha256 84e44d568a357ca02cd23db1a1f90c7cff72be0fcb383fdf3d1577880e40b8b3. The server returns A first, then B, and answers the matching If-None-Match with 304. `check --root Dep --repository http://127.0.0.1:50826/ --cache run-weak/cache --write-lock run-weak/lock.xml --json` exited 0 after a final model GET of 304; the lock contains A. Cached `--read-lock` exited 0; `--no-cache --read-lock` exited 1 with LOCK_MISMATCH; fresh `--no-cache --write-lock` exited 1 with CHANGED_SOURCE and wrote no lock. Last-Modified scenario: the server uses a whole-second Last-Modified and B adds DOMAIN D=TEXT (sha256 812137280c2fe01868dba7bbc8244f12e842254a66bb9738b29c81bece93d534). `check --cache --write-lock` exited 0 after a final If-Modified-Since GET of 304 and pinned A; cached `--read-lock` exited 0; `--no-cache --read-lock` exited 1 with LOCK_MISMATCH; fresh `--no-cache --write-lock` exited 1 with CHANGED_SOURCE. Raw HTTP logs, exits and digests are in build/review/repository-cache/r1/worktree/build/reviewer/weak-validators/ (run-weak/, run-weak-nocache/, run-lm/, run-lm-nocache/, evidence-manifest.json).

counterprobes.evidence: run-weak/out1.json status ok, model sha256 4579d2317136de116ddc45cb7ca4d2e1b7b37c5efdee29e1b240ca6b17d5c04b; run-weak/http.jsonl 4 requests, 2 body responses; final Dep.ili GET 304 with If-None-Match W/"dep-logical-1" after the server switched to B (sha256 84e44d568a357ca02cd23db1a1f90c7cff72be0fcb383fdf3d1577880e40b8b3); run-weak/lock.xml pins A.
run-weak/out2.json status ok with model sha256 A; HTTP log shows further 304 responses for Dep.ili while the server's current representation is B; no LOCK_MISMATCH is raised.
run-weak/out3.json status resolution rejected with reason LOCK_MISMATCH; 2 requests, 2 body responses; Dep.ili served as B sha256 84e44d568a357ca02cd23db1a1f90c7cff72be0fcb383fdf3d1577880e40b8b3.

run-weak-nocache/out1.json status resolution rejected with reason CHANGED_SOURCE; 4 requests, 4 body responses; A then B (sha256 84e44d568a357ca02cd23db1a1f90c7cff72be0fcb383fdf3d1577880e40b8b3); no lock written. This is the control showing the same server change is detected when no conditional cache is used.

run-lm/out1.json status ok, model sha256 4579d2317136de116ddc45cb7ca4d2e1b7b37c5efdee29e1b240ca6b17d5c04b; 4 requests, 2 body responses; final Dep.ili GET 304 with If-Modified-Since Sun, 01 Nov 2026 16:43:26 GMT after the server switched to B (sha256 812137280c2fe01868dba7bbc8244f12e842254a66bb9738b29c81bece93d534, adds DOMAIN D=TEXT); run-lm/lock.xml pins A.
run-lm/out2.json status ok with model sha256 A; further 304 responses for Dep.ili while B is current; no LOCK_MISMATCH.
run-lm/out3.json status resolution rejected with reason LOCK_MISMATCH; 2 requests, 2 body responses; Dep.ili served as B sha256 812137280c2fe01868dba7bbc8244f12e842254a66bb9738b29c81bece93d534.

run-lm-nocache/out1.json status resolution rejected with reason CHANGED_SOURCE; 4 requests, 4 body responses; A then B (sha256 812137280c2fe01868dba7bbc8244f12e842254a66bb9738b29c81bece93d534); no lock written. Control showing the same-second Last-Modified change is detected without the conditional cache.
